changes.title: Project update: Long Lake Upgrader
changes.body: Long Lake Upgrader: note changed from "HISTORICAL — idled indefinitely Jul 2016 after Jan 2016 hydrocracker explosion; never restarted. Site is SAGD-only (raw bitumen/dilbit). US$1.6B impairment. ST53 tracks SAGD bitumen." to "HISTORICAL: idled indefinitely Jul 2016 after Jan 2016 hydrocracker explosion; never restarted. Site is SAGD-only (raw bitumen/dilbit). US$1.6B impairment. ST53 tracks SAGD bitumen.".
changes.balance: Reference update; no direct balance read.
